annotations.title: Check if I'm ready to bid

description:
Check whether the user's business (their FindMyBids business profile) is ready to bid.

    Give ONE of: bid_id (a FindMyBids bid ID), url (link to any bid page or PDF, any state or private client),
    or text (pasted bid text). For url/text, also pass state (two letters), level ("federal"/"state"/"local"/
    "private") and due_date (ISO) if known.
    Returns a verdict, each requirement with status gap / check / ready / info, the sentence it came from,
    walkthrough links for registration gaps, and an excerpt of the bid to confirm against.
    Free accounts get 3 checks a month (shared with the website); Pro is unlimited.
